The strongest root-cause signal is **recommendationservice**. Starting at 13:10, its memory rises from about 44 MB to 134 MB, while open sockets climb from 5 to 14.5, request rate falls from 17.3 to 7.8 RPS, and p90 latency increases. At the same time, frontend latency and socket counts rise, and its logs report failures getting recommendations. The dependency map gives the propagation path **recommendationservice → frontend**.

This points to a memory-related degradation in recommendationservice. The telemetry does not show memory limits or OOM events, so it cannot establish the precise mechanism. The Jaeger export timeout is a telemetry-export warning; these data do not show that it caused user-facing failures.
